svg.title: Feature ELM
svg.desc: Extreme Learning Machines in C++20 and CUDA. An 8 by 8 digit passes through a random hidden layer to class scores, and Batch ELM training with 2048 hidden nodes runs about 27 times faster on an RTX 4080 than on the CPU.
svg.text: Extreme Learning Machines in C++20 · trained in one solve, on CPU or CUDA
